news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS in line with expectations, revenues disappoint
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹83.30 (up from ₹64.86 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹118.6b (up 6.3% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹1.40b (up 28% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 1.2% (up from 1.0% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue missed analyst estimates by 1.5%. Earnings per share (EPS) were mostly in line with analyst estimates. Revenue is forecast to grow 9.9% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 12% growth forecast for the Professional Services industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 7% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 15% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS exceeds analyst expectations while revenues lag behind
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹24.88 (up from ₹16.95 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹30.4b (up 3.9% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹417.2m (up 47% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 1.4% (up from 1.0% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue missed analyst estimates by 2.5%. Earnings per share (EPS) exceeded analyst estimates by 27%. Revenue is forecast to grow 12% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Professional Services industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 3% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 17% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.

news.title: TeamLease Services Limited Appoints Vamsikrishna Ithamraju As Chief Digital And Information Officer, Effective January 7, 2026
news.body: TeamLease Services Limited has appointed Mr. Vamsikrishna Ithamraju as Chief Digital and Information Officer (CDIO), effective January 7, 2026. As CDIO, Mr. Vamsikrishna Ithamraju shall lead the digital transformational projects and head the technology initiatives for TeamLease cluster. Mr. Vamsikrishna Ithamraju joins us and brings over two decades of experience in technology leadership across financial services, fintech, capital markets, and consulting. He has a strong track record of building and scaling high-performance engineering teams, modernizing legacy platforms, and driving cloud-native and AI-led transformations at scale.
